verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents a quickstart for going from a source file to structured output using Claude and plain-language prompts. Its Transform MCP server lets AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor and VS Code have Transform ingest local files and return partitioned, enriched, chunked and embedded data. Natural-language operation works only through external AI clients, and the evidence shows it only for Transform. Missing for 10: evidence that workflows, jobs and connectors can also be managed via natural language, a native in-product natural-language interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
